test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

A message was being typed by the assistant while the manager was speaking.

options.text: The assistant was typing a message while the manager was speaking.
The assistant typed a message while the manager spoke.
A message was typed while the manager was speaking.
The assistant types a message while the manager speaks.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 
 
• In the given sentence, the object "a message" becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "the assistant" at the beginning of the sentence. 
 
• Change the passive verb phrase "was being typed" to the active form "was typing."
